162 people die in a stampede at a Hindu temple in Naina Devi in the northern Indian state of Himachal Pradesh.
India: 2008 Naina Devi temple stampede: Stampede at a Hindu temple at Naina Devi in Bilaspur, Himachal Pradesh, kills 162 and injures 400.
2007 South Asian floods: Monsoon floods make millions homeless in India, Nepal and Bangladesh with a death toll of 145 in India and 65 in Bangladesh.
